Question Choices: A florist has a total of 4753 flowers. If each vase can hold exactly 11 flowers, then how many vases can be filled completely and how many flowers will be leftover?
Hints: Use long division; check divisor x quotient + remainder = dividend.
Solution: 47 / 11: write 4, subtract 44, leave 3; 35 / 11: write 3, subtract 33, leave 2; 23 / 11: write 2, subtract 22, leave 1. Quotient 432, remainder 1. Check: 11 x 432 + 1 = 4753; 0 <= 1 < 11. Answer: 432 full vases, 1 left over.
